structured_output.what_is_happening: A 12-minute-old copycat 'Kardashev Research' token, created straight on PumpSwap rather than through the pump.fun curve. Its only link is a Beff Jezos (beffjezos) X status. Over about 15 minutes it did roughly $280k of volume on a $41k market cap and rose about 265%. There were about 2,056 unique buyers against only 59 unique sellers. That pattern looks like bot or bundled buying. One wallet holds 49.36% of supply, and GMGN counts it as dev/team (dev_team_hold_rate 0.4947). 100% of the LP is unlocked. At least five other 'Kardashev Research' tokens are live, and the one launched earliest has already reached a $1.6M market cap.

narrative.description: A meme about Beff Jezos / e/acc and the Kardashev scale, apparently set off by a Beff Jezos post about 'Kardashev Research'. Tech-figure memes like this can draw real attention.
narrative.why_spreading: A tweet from a well-known accelerationist figure likely set off a rush of same-name launches. The original has already reached a $1.6M market cap, which shows real demand for the story.

token_connection.why_this_token: It uses the same name and ticker and links the same tweet. Nothing ties it to the original project. It is one of many clones launched within about 45 minutes.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 5wW9...hUnp is at a $1.6M market cap and was created about 45 minutes before this one, so it is likely the canonical token. AAye... has $1.96M in h1 volume at $91k. 6mzE..., GiSE..., 97AV... and several pump.fun clones share the same name.

authenticity.evidence: Unique buyers outnumber sellers about 2,056 to 59, which is implausibly one-sided. GMGN flags 25 bundler wallets and puts the bot/degen rate at 58.5% and the top bundler trader share at 55.6%. One wallet holds 49% and is counted as dev/team. The creator skipped the curve and set up the pool directly with unlocked LP.
authenticity.uncertainty: Some of the buyers could be real traders chasing the Beff Jezos tweet across clones. Still, the one-sided seller count and the team's 49% holding point to a farm-and-dump setup.

structural_risks: A single dev/team wallet holds 49.36% of supply and can dump it into about $32k of liquidity
100% of the LP is unlocked, so the pool creator can pull it
Clone of a token that is already established, and it trades among several other clones
Bundled or bot-driven buying: 25 bundlers, 58.5% bot/degen
GeckoTerminal shows the top 10 holders at 99%

structured_output.counterargument: The narrative is hot and the canonical token already holds a $1.6M market cap, so leftover demand could send a clone at $41k up 2x on momentum. If the 49% wallet sits still for a while, heavy buy pressure (996 buys in 5 minutes) could reach the take-profit before any dump.
unknowns: Whether the 49% wallet is the LP creator or dev, or some other account
Whether the linked Beff Jezos tweet endorses any specific contract
How much of the buyer count is real people versus bots

source_coverage.notes: No internet in this condition; judged from the packet only.

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat of a hot Beff Jezos narrative. It was deployed directly on PumpSwap with unlocked LP and a 49% dev/team holding, and the buying looks bot- or bundle-driven. It is most likely a quick extraction play: a rug or a large dump is more likely than a 2x from entry.
